headline: GPS-spoofing thieves steal data center gear, but loss estimates differ
summary: Highway thieves have been spoofing GPS signals, hacking accounts and staging hit-and-runs to steal data center equipment in transit. One outlet put the losses at $100 million, while another described losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars.
